notes: Lyrics for YouTube videos. A Lyrics button on the Pravah player, next to Comments, pulls time-synced lyrics from LRCLIB (a free, community-run lyrics database) when a match is found - the current line highlights and scrolls automatically as the video plays, and tapping any line jumps playback there. Falls back to plain scrollable text when only unsynced lyrics exist. Nothing is looked up until you press the button, and it has its own Settings toggle, same as Comments. A "New" tab for channels you follow. Pravah's Subscriptions area gets a third tab: an aggregated feed of the latest uploads across every channel you follow. No Google account, no login - it's the same public page load this app already makes when you open one channel at a time, just checked across all of them at once, with a Refresh action for more. Searching a channel surfaces its newest upload. Searching YouTube for a channel by its exact name now puts that channel's most recent video at the top of the results, instead of leaving you to open the channel page yourself for the same answer. Settings, tidied up. A handful of rows that had drifted into the wrong section (a few sleep-timer and Now Playing display toggles sitting under "Transport Controls") are back where their labels say they are.
